title: ShieldCare Labour Share by the Age of the Covered Item
content:
The share of the labour booked on a job that a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plan meets is set by how
far the covered item has run through the plan's term since the item was bought, measured in whole
months from the item's purchase day.

| How far the item has run | The share of the labour booked the plan meets |
| --- | --- |
| the covered item has run less than a third of the plan's term since it was bought | the whole of the labour booked, being 100 percent |
| the item has run less than two thirds of that term | 95 percent of the labour booked |
| every other item | 90 percent of the labour booked |

### Both sides of the fractions

On a plan whose term is 24 months, a third of the term is 8 months and two thirds is 16 months. An item 7 whole
months old has run less than a third and the whole of the labour is met. An item of exactly 8 whole months has
not run less than a third, so it falls to the second row, where 15 whole months is still less than two thirds
and 95 percent is met. An item of exactly 16 whole months has not run less than two thirds either, and 90
percent is met, as it is for anything older.

### Worked through on hypothetical figures

With labour of 300.00 booked in the window read on a plan whose term is 48 months: an item 15 whole
months old has run less than the 16 months that are a third of the term, so the labour met is 300.00;
an item 30 whole months old has run less than the 32 months that are two thirds, so the labour met is
285.00; an item 40 whole months old brings the labour met to 270.00.
